notes: Crafting: the inventory screen (Tab) has a "Make" list. Recipes you can make now come first; the rest show what is missing. Click one to make it, with a progress bar and a Cancel button while you work.
Fixed: in the packaged game you could not move or look after pressing Host on the start screen (the start screen kept the mouse cursor and ignored the keys).
